t: You're looking at Tribe and Tribulation, a sculpture by Serge Attukwei Clottey. Clottey is a Ghanaian artist, born in 1985, who works across installation, performance, photography and sculpture. He created Afrogallonism, an artistic concept that explores the place of the yellow oil gallons in consumption and necessity in modern African life. He is also the founder of Ghana's GoLokal, through which he tries to change society through art. Look closely at the materials and colours of the piece.
